admission.justification: Replaced temporary Phase 1 wire ceilings and additive appendix allowances with final single-source o200k_base token ceilings after weighing keeping Phase 1 allowances or word ceilings; governs every future capsule and handover change.

alternatives.option: Option A: Enforce final non-ratcheting WIRE_TOKEN_CEILINGS (2,500t / 3,000t / 3,800t across all 8 default launch pairs, including heldOpeningPrompt prefixes, with Phase 1 appendix allowances removed) and 34-key COMPILED_CAPSULE_TOKEN_CEILINGS (1,500 / 2,000 / 2,600 / 1,500) in wire_budget.py, retiring siloed word-ceiling enforcement while keeping frozen D681/D682/D694 snapshots.
alternatives.reason: Eliminates competing word-vs-token gates and interim appendix allowances with one o200k_base token authority in wire_budget.py enforced identically by renewal and test gates.

alternatives.option: Option B: Retain PHASE_1_WIRE_TOKEN_CEILINGS with additive 600/900-token appendix allowances and legacy word ceilings in capsule-budgets-current.json.
alternatives.reason: Keeps looser interim allowances and dual word/token ceilings that conflict with three-tier progressive disclosure and non-ratcheting token discipline.
alternatives.reconsider_when: If an approved future launch population requires a distinct appendix allowance model or tokenizer change.

consequences: DEC-4PGWAW is superseded; PHASE_1_WIRE_TOKEN_CEILINGS, PHASE_1_HELD_APPENDIX_ALLOWANCE, and PHASE_1_LAUNCH_APPENDIX_ALLOWANCE are removed from wire_budget.py.
scripts/instruction_renewal/budgets.py checks COMPILED_CAPSULE_TOKEN_CEILINGS and retains word counts only as informational derived.current_measurements notices.
Any ceiling increase remains an explicit developer decision enforced by wire_budget.py and test_role_wire_token_budgets.py.
context: CAP-L2 introduced interim PHASE_1_WIRE_TOKEN_CEILINGS with additive 600/900-token appendix allowances (DEC-4PGWAW) while legacy word ceilings remained in capsule-budgets-current.json. CAP-R03@v1 delivered three-tier progressive disclosure and inline handover deduplication, bringing all 8 default launch pairs (including heldOpeningPrompt prefixes) and all 34 compiled capsule matrix keys well below final token budgets.
decider: Heading Architect and Developer under approved CAP-R03@v1 (D971, D972, D976, D1031, D1032, D1034)
